_comment: Cleanup applied by npm run art:process. fillHoles: largest enclosed see-through region (in source pixels) to fill, per manifest id; a trailing * matches a prefix and an exact id wins. Use an object to repaint with a known color (color, plus shade along the outline) when the original color was keyed out, and rows [y0, y1] to fill between the outline on those rows when the outline itself is broken. List only sprites whose holes are damage, not real gaps. skip: ids art:process leaves alone, with the reason.

skip.tile_fence_v: the supplied piece is a side-on fence; until a top-down vertical piece exists the game builds one from tile_fence_h
